result.summary: The layout is largely coherent, but several elements are clipped or inconsistent: horizontally scrolled cards are hard-truncated at the viewport edge, a restaurant name is cut off without an ellipsis, the selected 'Pizza' filter does not match the listed content, and the favourite (heart) buttons use two different visual styles.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' category chip is shown as active/selected, yet the results below are poké, burgers, pasta and ramen restaurants — the filter appears to have no effect on the listings.
issues.suggestion: Apply the selected category filter to the listed sections, or deselect the chip so the default 'All' state is active on the home feed.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') is hard-cut by the screen edge and its name is truncated mid-word with no ellipsis, so it reads as broken text.
issues.suggestion: Add text-overflow ellipsis with a max width for card titles, and add consistent horizontal padding/peek so the next card is intentionally previewed rather than sliced.

issues.description: The favourite heart buttons use inconsistent styling: the Tokumaru card has a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below has a dark/transparent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardise the favourite button background, size and icon colour across all cards, using a single scrim treatment for legibility over imagery.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped at the right edge with a partially visible chip, giving no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient mask or consistent peek offset at the row edge so the horizontal scroll is discoverable and the cut looks deliberate.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is cut off by the bottom navigation bar with no bottom spacing, so its content sits directly under the nav.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the nav bar height so the last card can scroll fully clear of the tab bar.

issues.description: The notification bell badge and the promo banner's white-on-green secondary line ('Use code TALLINN3 ... min. order €10') are small/low-emphasis, risking readability for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Increase the subtitle font size/weight or contrast, and provide an accessible label for the notification badge state.
